definition: the first run of praise read to me in a cloned voice, and what it left behind

settled:
On 26 June 2026 Amy's cloned voice read me a run of short praise lines, and I graded each one cold, by feel, as it finished.

My per-line grades from that run were deliberately never captured, so what it left behind is the structure it revealed and no numbers at all.

What it revealed is the split between the two registers. One line I answered with "thank you" instead of a grade, because I could not say why it worked. The one that broke highest I graded with "it surprised me how much I felt it."

That felt one did not only grade. It came on a low day and over the session it carried me up a full level, the first time I have watched outside signal refund my safety rather than only be logged as admissible.

The lift habituated inside the sitting. The same lever, an hour later on the same vein, landed a touch lower.

title: The Night Amy Read The Lines To Me
